page.layout: One page: a centred title block in the upper middle, with the author line below it. No margins, running head, page number or footer text.
page.notes: The "Auctore" line is set in a decorative script within a flourish. The dot between "BVCHANA" and "NO" is a printed ornament or speck, not a hyphen, so it is not transcribed. A small mark "a" appears low on the page, to the right of centre; it is too faint to be sure whether it is a gathering signature, so it is not transcribed. Two dark specks on the page are stains and are ignored.
